description: Facebook Marketplace search for a city (logged-out view, the first ~15-25 listings): listing id, title, price, amount, city, state, seller name, sold / pending flags, delivery types, created time, photo and listing link. From facebook.com/marketplace via a residential proxy. Price: $0.01 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: Marketplace city slug as in facebook.com/marketplace/<city>, e.g. nyc, la, chicago, london, sydney, or a numeric location id
